corrections.reason: No change needed if printed ሂዳችሁ, wait let's check Col 1 L21: it clearly has ሂዳችሁ (or ሄዳችሁ? Wait: it has the diagonal stroke at bottom right of ሀ, which is ሂ or ሄ; actually no change needed).
In the image at the end of Col 2 L08, the glyph after ወ is the ligature/numeral ፩ with ዱ underneath/attached (ወ፩ዱ), matching Col 3 L38 (ወመጽኡ እለ አሠርቱ ወ፩ዱ ሰዓት).
Classical Ge'ez imperfective verb ዘያበዝኅ takes 6th order (ሳድስ) ኅ, and the printed glyph has the 6th-order top hook of ኅ.
